listing.name: The Lost World: Jurassic Park Special Edition / Alexbeav PSXRecomp
listing.summary: Play The Lost World: Jurassic Park Special Edition with a native player built from your matching original disc.

steps.title: Supply the exact original disc
steps.instruction: Use your own USA The Lost World: Jurassic Park Special Edition disc, SLUS-00515, with all 3 tracks present.

steps.title: Prepare the managed Windows or Linux player
steps.instruction: Select the complete matching disc as a CHD in Portcove. Portcove prepares and builds the player locally using the kit’s bundled OpenBIOS. On Linux, put your native C/C++ compiler, CMake, Ninja and Python 3 on PATH. The bundled emitters need glibc 2.14 and GLIBCXX 3.4.26. Choose Play after preparation.

steps.title: Prepare the Mac or a separate upstream-owned copy
steps.instruction: For standalone Linux setup, the packaged host needs glibc 2.29, GLIBCXX 3.4.26, OpenGL and zlib. On macOS 11 or later, choose the Intel or Apple Silicon ZIP for your system and put the Xcode Command Line Tools, CMake, Ninja and Python 3 on PATH. Run the upstream The_Lost_World__Jurassic_Park_Special_Edition_Recompiled setup host and complete Generate & rebuild with your own matching original. Keep all tracks together for a CUE image. Add build-release/The_Lost_World__Jurassic_Park_Special_Edition_Recompiled as the player, with build-release as the start folder. Use the kit’s supported BIOS instructions for an upstream-owned copy.

warnings: Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay for this package.
The source check uses first data-track identity and track count. Keep the full original disc intact. Mac setup, native gameplay and populated-save compatibility remain unobserved.

references.title: Keep the data and runtime you actually use
references.instruction: For Portcove-managed copies, compatible replacement preserves declared saves, settings, mods and overlay captures. Keep the original disc separately. For an upstream-owned copy, retain the complete creating folder and back up your saves and settings before replacement.
